name: VEIKK Creator VK640 V2
summary: VEIKK Creator VK640 V2 - VK640 - Graphic Tablets - 8mm thickness and 279g weight make VK640 drawing tablet sleek and light enough to slide right into your bag or bring on the go, making it easy to use anywhere. 6 customizable shortcut keys make your work
description_html:
8mm thickness and 279g weight make VK640 drawing tablet sleek and light enough to slide right into your bag or bring on the go, making it easy to use anywhere. 6 customizable shortcut keys make your work more efficient and convenient.


Portable and Compact: Features a 6x4 inch compact working area, yet still designed to break through the limit between express keys and drawing area. 8mm thickness and 279g weight make it sleek and lightweight to slip right into your bag or carry on the go.


Super Efficient: 6 customized shortcut keys. You can program for your favorite keyboard shortcuts, like zoom in/out, brush size +/-, undo, etc., which can improve efficiency and create a highly convenient work platform.


Natural and Precise: 16384 levels of pressure sensitivity pen, which makes the lines transition from thin to thick will be fluid and precisely under your control. ±60°Tilt makes a digital stylus draw as natural as a real pencil. It is suitable for sketching, shading as well as creating stylized paintings. The battery-free pen does not need to charge or replace the battery. Create fluently at any time and no need to worry about whether the battery will run out.


To the platform your love: Compatible with Windows 7 or later, macOS 10.12 or later, Linux, and Android 6.0 or above phone (Check Android FAQs first to see if your phone supported) with the OTG connector. You can use it on most creating programs, such as Photoshop, Krita, Illustrator, SAI, SketchBook Pro, Fire Alpaca, Open Canvas, Manga Studio, ibisPaint, Medibang and so on.


Write, Draw, Play, Sign:Designed for drawing, painting, designing, sketching, E-signatures, osu!gaming etc. It is also an ideal tool for Online Teaching & Learning and Web conferences & Live broadcasts.


Compact, Portable and Perfectly Efficient


Make Your Creation


Easier

The VK640 comes with 6 comfortable-to-touch custom shortcuts that you can program for your favorite keyboard shortcuts, such as zoom in/out, brush size +/-, undo, etc., to streamline your workflow and increase productivity.


Take It Anywhere You Want To Go

The VK640 features a 6x4-inch working area, a thickness of just 8mm, and a weight of 279g.


It slips easily into your computer bag or carry-on bag, perfect for capturing your fleeting thoughts at any time.


In addition, the tablet comes with 4 silicone anti-slip feet, so you can place it more stably and are less likely to slip.


Bring Your Art Learning To A New Level

The VK640 drawing tablet offers 16384 levels of pressure sensitivity, giving you precise control from fine lines to bold strokes.


With the P05 battery-free pen, you can create anytime without charging or batteries, keeping your workflow uninterrupted.


The ±60° tilt support delivers a natural pen-like experience, making sketching, shading, and illustration more expressive and intuitive.


290 PPS report rate, supporting fast and smooth line input, so your every idea won't lag.


5080 LPl resolution, allowing you to express yourself more freely and focus more on details.


One Tablet, Endless Ways

Sketch

Turn quick ideas into clear sketches anytime with smooth pen control for daily inspiration and creativity.


Drawing Practice

Build core drawing skills and try different styles as you practice lines, shapes, and simple illustrations.


E-Learning

Support online learning with easy note-taking and interactive study materials for better focus and understanding.


Document Annotation & Signature

Mark up PDFs, highlight key points, and sign documents quickly for study, work, and daily tasks.


Integrated USB Cable Design

VK640 tablet is designed with an integrated USB cable. You don't need to worry about losing the cable and interrupting your creation. It is easier for you to take it outside or on the way.


Work The Way You Like

VK640 pen tablet is compatible with Windows 7 or later, macOS 10.12 or later, Linux, and Android 6.0 or later.


You can use it on most authoring programs such as Photoshop, Krita, Illustrator, SAI, SketchBook Pro, Fire Alpaca, Open Canvas, Manga Studio, ibisPaint, Medibang, etc.


What’s in the Box

1 x VK640 Pen Tablet

1 x P05 Battery-free Pen

1 x Pen Pocket

1 x Pen Holder

28 x Pen Nibs

1 x Nib Extractor

1 x Quick Start Guide

1 x Driver Download Card

description_html_ar:
اكتب وارسم على جرافيك تابلت VEIKK VK640 والتي تبلٌغ مساحته 6x4 بوصة مما يجعله سهلاً للتنقل واختصر وقتك مع 6 مفاتيح اختصاريُمكنك تخصيصهم لزيادة كفاءة عملك وجعله أكثر سهولة

رفيقك المثالي للكتابة، الرسم، اللعب، والتوقيع: أداة احترافية تدعم التلوين والتصميم والتخطيط والتوقيع الرقمي وألعاب osu.

يتميز بمرونة استثنائية تجعله الخيار الأفضل للدراسة عبر الإنترنت، حضور الاجتماعات والمؤتمرات الافتراضية، وإدارة البث المباشر. 


حساسية عالية 

ارسم بدقة مع قلم لا يحتاج إلى بطارية أو شحن للعمل، يدعم 16 ألف مستوى من مستويات حساسية الضغط، مع ±60° من حساسية الإمالة. 

الرسم بالقلم طبيعيًا تمامًا كالرسم بالقلم الرصاص، فهو مناسب للرسم والتظليل، مما يتيح لك الإبداع بسلاسة.


يتوافق الجهاز اللوحي بأنظمة التشغيل : 

Windows 10 أو أحدث

Mac OS X 10.12 أو أحدث 

Linux

 Android 6.0 أو أحدث 


يمكنك تشغيل تابلت الرسم مع البرامج الرئيسية مثل :  

Photoshop وKrita وIllustrator وSAI وSketchBook Pro وFire Alpaca وOpen Canvas وManga Studio وibisPaint وMedibang وغيرها.



محتويات العلبة

1x جرافيك تابلت 

1x قلم بدون بطارية 

28 x سنون

1 x Pen Pocket

1 x Pen Holder

1 x Nib Extractor 

1 x دليل التشغيل 

1 x Driver Download Card
